we have some feedback from the client that Lauren and I still have to review together but just wanted to get ahead bc ur ahead in time zone!

In general I think the site looks great. I have some points to feed back:

- The menu doesn't display straight away, only when you scroll down - is this intentional, I don't recall this being part of the design?

- The cart icon is a shopping cart, I think this looks a bit cheap and it should be a bag icon instead

- On mobile the most prominent item on the menu is 'sign in', I don't recall that being part of the design, can we remove it?

- The first image on the home page doesn't seem to animate (ie the brick wall doesn't open?)

- On the selection page (eg https://rooms-e-comm.myshopify.com/pages/the-5-piece), we agreed that clicking on 'view item details' should take you to the product page but it looks like when clicking on the product image then you're taken to the product page as well, I don't think that visitors should be taken away from that page so easily. Also there doesn't appear to be a scrolling function between products?

- On the 'individual items' page (eg https://rooms-e-comm.myshopify.com/collections/all), we agreed that there would be product above the fold however the line illustration is taking up that full area on mobile again? Also on this page, on desktop the product tiles are square, however on mobile they're portrait - we need to have this consistent across both otherwise it will be really difficult to manage the product images so they look good on both desktop and mobile.


I would disregard point 1 about the menu, we can talk about that and convince her we like that way


but do change the shopping cart and follow our design please!

rawDescription: We opened up the home page using a desktop computer and it does not seem to fit to the page. Seems too big. We like the search bar, but we don't like the location. It should be at the very top, in the toolbar.For the location part, on enterprise.com you can put in your postal code and it will automatically generate the municipality that it corresponds to.If it's possible to have that function, let's go with that. We would also like to keep this open to other municipalities, only that if a customer requests for a municipality outside of where we currently serve, we want a message to pop up that we are sold out in their area and give the customer the option to leave their email address, desired date of rental, and type or category of bouncy castle and provide them with a message that we will let them know if any become available for their desired date and category. This way, we will be able to track the demand from other areas and expand the business into those areas where the man is greatest.The products button and the how it works button should be removed from the Top toolbar all together.The products button can be towards the bottom, right under the categories. Again, just like it is on the enterprise.com website. Please get rid of the red starts from cad 400 a day on the main homepage. The rent now Button on the toolbar needs to not allow the customer to proceed unless and until the location and date of rental is inputted. The how it works should be changed also.Can you please change it to the following four steps? You book Your Castle, we set it up, you enjoy the castle, we pick it up. Product Listing:The way this is displayed right now is basically a big browse sheet of all inventory. We don't want to have that. We don't want customers getting lost in the inventory they are not going to be able to rent because it doesn't match up with their date. This product listing should always be filtered by the desired date and location. We don't want to have an all inventory search option. Just like on enterprise.com if they want to see all of our products it should take them back to the categories. And then we can provide details of that category. We think it's unlikely we are going to have it many if any customers that are looking for a specific bouncy castle and don't care when or where it is going to be used. Even though we might lose some customers that would like to search on that way, we think it outweighed by our need to continually move the customers towards finalizing the booking. Here is a link: Example for product listing page from enterprise after the location and dates have been selected (and categories can be selected and de-selected on the side): https://www.enterprise.ca/en/reserve.html#car_select There will be three categories: Bouncy castle, obstacle course, and water slide. Some products May fit into more than one category, and we will deal with that once we have the actual products in hand.

rawDescription: Remove unnecessary themes from the store.Improve speed of the store in mobile and desktop
description:
Remove unnecessary themes from the store.

Improve speed of the store in mobile and desktop

Please make the following changes to the text:


Replace "authorized payment" with "confirmed payment"


Change "estimated time for receiving an order" to "estimated delivery time"

Replace "the order will be shipped the soonest" with "the order will be shipped as soon as possible"


Use "approximately" instead of "approx" and specify the currency for international orders in the sentence "We charge a fixed rate of AED 30 for domestic orders and approximately AED 120 for international orders depending on the weight of the package."


Instead of "must be settled by the customer to the courier," use "must be paid by the customer to the courier at the time of delivery."


Rephrase "K Mansoori will not deal or provide any services or products to any of OFAC sanctions countries in accordance with the law of UAE" to "According to UAE law, K Mansoori cannot provide services or products to any countries subject to OFAC sanctions."


Replace the last sentence with "It is the customer's responsibility to track their shipment and ensure its receipt."

"it's" should be "its" in the sentence "Our focus is to elevate embroidery to it’s defining class."


The apostrophe in "it's door" should be removed to make it "its door."


The sentence "When you think about what defines a modern Emirati Woman, you think of someone who is confident, bold, ambitious, and one who carries her culture proudly" should e changed it to "When you think about what defines a modern Emirati Woman, you think of someone who is confident, bold, ambitious, and proud of her culture."

TaskName: Corrections on Exchange and return page
description:
Change "hence" to "therefore" for better clarity.


In the sentence "Customers are required to notify us of a defective item within 48hours of receiving the shipment," it would be clearer to say "within 48 hours of receiving the order" instead of "shipment."


Instead of saying "otherwise it is deemed that the product was received in a good condition," it would be clearer to say "otherwise the product is assumed to be in good condition."


In the sentence "Items should be returned new, unworn, unwashed, undamaged and unused with the original tags attached within 7 days," it would be clearer to say "Items must be returned in new, unworn, unwashed, undamaged, and unused condition with the original tags attached within 7 days."


In the sentence "Customers would be eligible for a refund which would be made back to their same credit/debit cards," it would be clearer to say "Customers will receive a refund back to their original method of payment (credit/debit card)."


In the sentence "Returns and refunds are not applicable for refusing to accept delivery of an order," it would be clearer to say "Returns and refunds are not applicable if the customer refuses to accept delivery of an order."


In the sentence "CANCELLATION: Customers can cancel their orders within 1hr of purchase and refunds will be made back to their original mode of payment," it would be clearer to say "Cancellation: Customers can cancel their orders within 1 hour of purchase and will receive a refund back to their original method of payment."

TaskName: Corrections on Return and Refund page
description:
On TReturns & Refunds section // Redesign ( TAB also showing with //Redesign)


few grammar errors that need to be corrected


"hence" should be followed by a comma.

"defective item" should be pluralized to "defective items" to match the subject of the sentence.

"it is deemed that the product was received in a good condition" should be rephrased to "the product will be assumed to have been received in good condition."

"Customers would be eligible for a refund" should be changed to "Customers are eligible for a refund."

"Returns and refunds are not applicable for refusing to accept delivery of an order" should be rephrased to "Returns and refunds are not applicable for orders that are refused upon delivery."

description:
Brief: We aim to reduce our mobile load times from ~8s to half a second.


Context:

The updated codebase should result in faster load times and improved website stability. Update the existing landing pages to be faster, but keep the same layout / functionality.


APIs & Scripts to Remove

  1. Clarity.
  2. This was a heatmap tracker that they no longer use.
  3. Bold Commerce
  4. Upsell tool that they no longer use.
  5. Getshogun.com
  6. Visual page builder e-commerce replaced by Replo.
  7. One Click Upsell - Zipify OCU
  8. make sure scripts are not running on the Gel & Dip Landing Page (still being worked on).


Acceptance Criteria:


  1. Write mobile-first code and optimize pages for mobile navigation.
  2. Load JavaScript assets asynchronously: Move script tags to the bottom of the page near the closing </body> tag. This way older browsers that don’t support the async attribute will load the script after parsing the rest of the page.
  3. Each page should be optimized to load under one second.
  4. Images and videos should be optimized for fast rendering, ideally not weighing over 70 kbs. Adhere to Shopify’s Best Practices.
  5. Use concise and direct image names. Search engines crawl image file names. e.g., You could use the generic name your camera assigned to the image (e.g., DCMIMAGE10.jpg). However, it would be much better to name the file 2012-Ford-Mustang-LX-Red.jpg.
  6. Optimize “alt” attributes.
  7. Choose your image dimensions and product angles wisely and name them descriptively for SEO.
  8. Use a smaller image on the page and allow visitors to view a larger image in a pop-up or separate page.
  9. Always use JPEG. Never use GIFs for large product images. If you need to use PNG, try PNG-8 instead of PNG-24 —it’s better for decorative images, such as nail colors.
  10. Enable browser caching for mobile.
  11. Minimize web server response times.
  12. Use Content Distribution Networks (CDN).
  13. Enable font compression.
  14. Reduce redirects.
  15. Minimize Time to First Byte (TTFB) to below 200ms. Anything higher than 600ms will need to be investigated.
  16. Reduce the number of plugins: Some plugins will increase the TTFB time (e.g., Vimeo Embed Video) because they require additional processing on the server for each page request.

Details: 


Client wants to set an membership program in their store using the below app: 

https://apps.shopify.com/membership-program


Client store: https://seadon.co/

----------------------------------------------

Here's more detail about the membership program, can you please understand it and see if the Conjured app can offer these features:


How Will The System Work?


1. You will need to register your club profile on our website. This is NOT the same as just signing up for a user profile on our site. This feature will only be available once we launch the VIP portal on our website.


2. Once you've created your club profile, you will be able to gain access to all the club benefits (more detail below) assigned to your tier, through our website.


3. You will have your own club profile and dashboard to navigate and customize.


Club Benefits:

Here is a preview of the benefits we are thinking of:


Exclusive discounts

Gated content such as Backer's Blogs, Trail Lab, Gear Tryout, and more...

No minimum free shipping

Early access and deals to our product launches


Membership Tiers:

There are 3 main tiers:


1. Non-Kickstarter Backers- They will have to top-up $10 to activate their club profile, which would turn into store credits that they can use to order Seadon products at a discounted rate. After 1 month, if they are enjoying the benefits of the program, they can choose to stay or upgrade by selecting one of our paid packages. For example, $10 per month or XXX yearly. Details will be finalized with the voting of our community.


2. Kickstarter Backers- For Backers who backed one of the main rewards on our Kickstarter campaign (any reward apart from the 'Seadon VIP Club' reward), they will get access for free for 12 months.


For those who backed the 'Seadon VIP Club' reward ($10), you will get access for 1 month. After that, if you wish to keep or upgrade, you can.


Kickstarter Backers will have exclusive perks that no other tiers will get access to, such as gated content for our product development and gear tryouts. Backers only products and discounts etc...


3. Annual Members- For our most loyal customers. Pay yearly to get the most perks. If you are a Kickstarter Backer who upgrades to a yearly plan, you will receive even more perks.


Thanks,


Carson

I've recorded a Loom video stating the issue, but I will write it briefly below:

What is happening is when you try selecting a different variant that isn't the colorway that the pop-up is defaulted to, it doesn't get added to your customizer selection list. Regardless of which colorway the customer decides, it needs to be added to the selection list.


The loom video will clarify more and show you a visual of what is happening.


This client is about to start her BFCM sale next week, so we need this fixed ASAP before then. If you are available to help us fix this, please let me know, because if not we will need to source elsewhere.


We would need this fixed on the draft theme: 11.17/2023 Theme - Sarah Hendler

description:
Can you please add a new doctor, Dr. Emily Williams and update my bio/headshot on the website in "Meet Our Doctors" and "About Our practice" to:


Dr. Kara Kramer is a Board Certified periodontist and implant surgeon. She spends her time in private practice at West Cobb Periodontics and Implant Dentistry. She volunteers with residents at the Ben Massell Dental Clinic in Atlanta, GA. From 2019-2023, she was an adjunct assistant professor at Emory University School of Medicine, Department of Oral Surgery. She is active in professional societies including the ADA, GDA, Hinman and Pierre Fauchard Academy.

Dr. Kara Kramer is a Board Certified periodontist and implant surgeon. She spends her time in private practice at West Cobb Periodontics and Sandy Springs Periodontics. She volunteers with residents at the Ben Massell Dental Clinic in Atlanta, GA. From 2019-2023, she was an adjunct assistant professor at Emory University School of Medicine, Department of Oral Surgery. She is active in professional societies including the ADA, GDA, Hinman and Pierre Fauchard Academy

She received her undergraduate degree at the University of Georgia. She then continued her education at Nova Southeastern University College of Dental Medicine, graduating in 2014 with honors and serving as the class president. She completed her periodontics and implant dentistry residency at NYU Langone Hospital. There, she received extensive training in IV sedation and surgical aspects of dental implants and periodontal surgery.

Dr. Kramer’s philosophy is to treat patients as if they were her own family members, with warmth and compassion. She is passionate about periodontics and finds fulfillment in educating her patients how taking care of the gums can positively affect our overall health.



Dr. Williams bio:


Dr. Emily Williams, an Atlanta native, is a board eligible periodontist and implant surgeon. She graduated summa cum laude from Sewanee: The University of the South, where she earned a Bachelors of Arts in Latin and was elected to Phi Beta Kappa. She matriculated to the Dental College of Georgia, where she was one of only four percent of students in her class elected to both Omicron Kappa Upsilon, the national dental honor society, and Alpha Upsilon Phi, the national dental service and leadership society. In dental school, she was a writer and editor for Contour, the magazine of the American Student Dental Association, with a column on teeth and art history. She completed her periodontics and implant dentistry residency and Masters of Science in Dentistry at Louisiana State University in New Orleans, one of only two programs in the United States where residents additionally train in periodontal microsurgery. Here she was selected by faculty to become chief resident. She is trained in IV sedation and a comprehensive range of periodontal, soft tissue, and implant procedures.

 

Dr. Williams is excited to work with Dr. Kramer at West Cobb Periodontics. She loves being a periodontist both for the long lasting relationships formed with patients and being at the cutting edge of dental research. Dr. Williams herself had never heard of the field of periodontics until dental school, so she understands that patients may have many questions!

Hi Team,

Could you please add a service page for sedation dentistry, wisdom teeth removal, and same-day crowns? You can just use the standard content from our content library.

Also, please add an Anesthesia service page with the below info:


Unlocking Comfort and Tranquility: General Anesthesia Services at Canyon Vista Dental

Welcome to Canyon Vista Dental, where your comfort and well-being are our top priorities. We understand that dental treatments can sometimes evoke anxiety and concern. That's why we are delighted to introduce our specialized service: General Anesthesia. Led by the experienced Dr. Travis Shore, our practice is dedicated to providing you with a seamless and reassuring dental experience. Delve into the realm of General Anesthesia and discover how it can revolutionize your dental journey.


What Exactly is General Anesthesia and How Can It Benefit You?

Q: What is General Anesthesia, and how does it work? A: General Anesthesia is a remarkable technique that induces a state of unconsciousness using carefully administered medications. This state allows you to remain completely unaware and asleep during dental procedures, ensuring a pain-free and anxiety-free experience.

Q: Who can benefit from General Anesthesia? A: General Anesthesia is designed for various scenarios. It is advantageous for individuals of all ages, from kids to adults, and even special needs adults. Whether it's overcoming dental anxiety, minimizing discomfort, or addressing complex treatments, General Anesthesia is a versatile solution.

Q: What advantages does General Anesthesia offer for kids? A: Dental visits can be intimidating for kids, causing unease and apprehension. With General Anesthesia for kids, your child can sail through dental procedures without fear. It creates a serene environment, enabling the dental team to perform necessary treatments while your child sleeps peacefully.

Q: How does General Anesthesia enhance the experience for adults? A: For adults, dental anxiety can be a significant hurdle in seeking essential treatments. General Anesthesia alleviates this anxiety by allowing you to remain completely unconscious during the procedure. It also enables our skilled professionals to efficiently conduct comprehensive treatments, reducing the number of appointments required.

Q: What about special needs adults? A: We are proud to offer General Anesthesia for special needs adults, ensuring their dental experience is as comfortable and positive as possible. Our team is well-versed in catering to diverse needs and providing personalized care that takes into account each individual's requirements.

Nurturing Safety and Addressing Concerns

Q: Is General Anesthesia safe for everyone? A: Safety is paramount. Our experienced team conducts a thorough assessment of your medical history and current health to ensure General Anesthesia is appropriate for you. Rest assured, we prioritize your safety at every step.

Q: How long does it take to recover from General Anesthesia? A: Recovery times vary from person to person. Our team will provide you with comprehensive aftercare instructions to guide you through a smooth recovery process. We monitor your progress closely to address any concerns promptly.

Q: Are there any risks associated with General Anesthesia? A: Like any medical procedure, General Anesthesia carries potential risks. However, our seasoned anesthesia team takes meticulous precautions to minimize these risks. Your well-being is our utmost concern.

Q: Can General Anesthesia be chosen for any dental procedure? A: General Anesthesia is generally recommended for complex, lengthy, or anxiety-inducing procedures. Our team will carefully evaluate your needs and suggest the most suitable anesthesia option for your specific situation.

Embark on a Journey of Dental Serenity with Canyon Vista Dental

If the idea of a calm and pain-free dental experience resonates with you, Canyon Vista Dental is here to guide you through this transformative journey. Dr. Travis Shore and his compassionate team are dedicated to answering your queries and assisting you in making an informed decision regarding General Anesthesia. Reach out to us at (520)-458-4646 to schedule a consultation. Your dental comfort awaits.

rawDescription: While implementing code, some small issues are occurring, like: 1. When generating one document, the dashboard counter is incremented, but when it should be destroyed as per the time limit, the counter does not decrease.2. In the current system flow, each demand file will be read twice, once with normal OCR and once with OCRmyPDF. So now we want the demand file to be read only once with OCRmyPDF.3. If OpenAI gives 8 or more entities as ‘Not Found’ value out of 9, then it should not decrement the company’s credits.6. description:
While implementing code, some small issues are occurring, like:


1. When generating one document, the dashboard counter is incremented, but when it should be destroyed as per the time limit, the counter does not decrease.

2. In the current system flow, each demand file will be read twice, once with normal OCR and once with OCRmyPDF. So now we want the demand file to be read only once with OCRmyPDF.

3. Make proper format of ‘Inguries’, 'Ingection', and 'surgery' entities.

4. Solve the problem when OpenAI gives the response ‘Client Name’ as ‘Client Names'; that was an issue because we matched the ‘Client Name’ key name only for further processing in code.

5. If OpenAI gives 8 or more entities as ‘Not Found’ value out of 9, then it should not decrement the company’s credits.

6. Read only 35 pages of the Damand file, no matter what conditions are in consideration.

7. What if OpenAI changes the format of the response while we are requesting it?

8.Check representation when ‘Healthcare Providers’ were ‘Not Found.’

9.Check progress bar activity while processing.

10.Queue status count.

11.Traceback Error : 'KeyError' from OpenAI file.

12. Adding one function for when OpenAI gives 80% above 'Not Found' as a value of providers' amount.

13. EMS and police status updates.

Then apply the shipping costs the same way for dealers as you would for customers.


3. Please update the home page of the Shaker site with a new promotion code: "DIY23" This will replace the current discount code of SPR21. Have the discount code of DIY23 expire on June 30, 2024. Please activate this new discount and delete the old promotion (SPR21).

Barry Drexler, Senior Professional in Human Resources (SPHR)


Barry is a Human Resources (HR) Consultant, Expert Witness, Interview Coach, and Career Expert. As an HR Consultant he advises corporate clients on Strategic Planning, Leadership, Policy Development, Performance Management, Compensation/Benefits, Governance, and Recruitment & Selection.


As an interview coach and career expert, Barry has successfully trained over 2000 clients globally, from entry level to CEO’s, in all industries and specializations. He provides constructive and inspirational career coaching that has propelled his clients to succeed in their careers and exceed their potential.


Prior to becoming an Independent HR Consultant, Barry spent over thirty years as a Global HR executive at prominent international firms in New York, including; Vice President, HR, Lloyds Banking Group, Vice President, HR, Lehman Brothers, Vice President HR, CommerzeBank, and HR Officer, Morgan Stanley.


Barry appears frequently as an HR expert on major networks, including Fox Business News, CBS, and Fox News NY at 10. He is also quoted often in publications & online news, including cnbc.com, cnn.com, Phycology Today, & Inc. Magazine.


----------------------------------------------------------


Jill Belongia

Jill Belongia YogaFit Apprentice Manager is a Certified Yoga Therapist, holds an E-RYT 500 through the Yoga Alliance, and Group Fitness and Health Coach Certifications through the American Council on Exercise. She is also a Senior Master Trainer with YogaFit, a Nutrition Response Testing Practitioner, and trained in CranioSacral therapy. Before transitioning to fitness and wellness training, Jill was a music expert & educator in elementary, junior high, and high school music classrooms and band rooms.


Since 2003, Jill works with clients of all ages, individually and in small groups, to help them build strength and flexibility, to learn breathing and relaxation techniques, and to help them find balance...in the physical body, and in life.

1. User Side:

Admin Side:

description:
https://community.shopify.com/c/shopify-design/how-to-create-collections-of-variants-or-something-similar/m-p/1606555


We want a collection called "Bulk Matcha" which contains MS-MATCHA-G-1KG, MS-MATCHA-EM-1KG, and MS-MATCHA-SEN-1KG


Shopify DOES NOT allow us to create a collection by selecting VARIANTS, we need to create a collection in Shopify of specific variants. the solution is here in this


Here is a forum reply, we can follow these steps to achieve what the client is looking for:

Hi, Exist multiple ways to do this, my favorite is a mix using collection, collection metafields and custom code.


Example Blue Rugs:


create an automated collection. for this example, I use 2 parameters:


variant's title contains "blue"


Product type is equal to "rug"


chefJuanPi_0-1681577464224.png


you can use other parameters depending your needs.


after that create a collection's metafield that will help you to find the right variant.


chefJuanPi_1-1681577997667.png


In this example, I choose a variant title. so I will write the same text "blue" as I write on the automated definition.


This way you can create other variations easily like a collection of "Red carpets" or "small mugs" or anything you need.


Next step you should validate the collection to be sure your definition give you the right products.


there we arrive at the Best part CUSTOM CODE:


Depending on the complexity of your theme you can edit the default code (collection template, section, and snippets) or you can create new files.


I prefer to create new files with that I'm 100% sure my changes will not affect other collections on the site.


I recommend you create a new template based on your default collection template. you can name it collection.byVariants.json


Come back to the collection and select the template.


I can't give you an exact code because will depend a lot on your theme but the base principles to apply will be the same with any theme.


BASE PRINCIPLES:


- you should iterate on each variant of each product on the collection and use the collection's metafield to find the right variant.


- use the variant components to:


show the product images


include the variant Id on the product page link to go directly to the right variant like this:


THE_PRODUCT-URL?variant=VARIANT_ID


you can create a button buy now directly on the collection page using the variant id to cut steps for the customers.

rawDescription: Hello @hetalbhojani, we want to address some fixes we want regarding the website so we can move forward to the next website.1) Is there any other way to improve Speed Score rather than deleting apps on Shopify? We have looked into it as much as we can and we can't seem to find a workaround on it. It's very important for us to have better speed.2) There is no preview of the items price when it's on sale. Also within the product page, when a customer clicks on the "Select Size" button he should be able to see the original price crossed out with the final sale price next to it.3) The "from" price should always be the smallest price regardless of the size, availability etc4) We want the add to cart button to appear regardless of whether the customer has clicked on a size. ( I will attach photos explaining it later)5) When a customer tries to add a sold out size/item to cart, the error text we want displayed is: "This product is sold out."6) We want the "Sold out" graphic to appear on the top left just like the rest of the buttons. I don't remember if this is implemented but sold out should appear only when all the sizes are sold out. On some items there are just a few sizes that are sold out, we want a strikethrough on the price and a sold out label, indicating that it's no longer available.7) Klarna logo is not implemented in the supported payment options graphic. Is this a fix on your side or ours?
description:
Hello @hetalbhojani, we want to address some fixes we want regarding the website so we can move forward to the next website.


1) Is there any other way to improve Speed Score rather than deleting apps on Shopify? We have looked into it as much as we can and we can't seem to find a workaround on it. It's very important for us to have better speed.


2) There is no preview of the items price when it's on sale. Also within the product page, when a customer clicks on the "Select Size" button he should be able to see the original price crossed out with the final sale price next to it.


3) The "from" price should always be the smallest price regardless of the size, availability etc


4) We want the add to cart button to appear regardless of whether the customer has clicked on a size. ( I will attach photos explaining it later)


5) When a customer tries to add a sold out size/item to cart, the error text we want displayed is: "This product is sold out."


6) We want the "Sold out" graphic to appear on the top left just like the rest of the buttons. I don't remember if this is implemented but sold out should appear only when all the sizes are sold out. 

On some items there are just a few sizes that are sold out, we want a strikethrough on the price and a sold out label, indicating that it's no longer available.


7) Klarna logo is not implemented in the supported payment options graphic. Is this a fix on your side or ours?

description:
HEADER: SPECIAL GUEST SPEAKERS


Dr John J. Giordano PhD

Doctor Of Humane Letters,

CCJS, MAC, CAP

Dr. John Giordano is an expert in the treatment of addiction, mental health, and the founder of The National Institute For Holistic Addiction Studies (NIFHAS). He is the author of “Proven Holistic Treatment For Addiction & Chronic Relapse”, “How To Beat Your Addictions And Live A Quality Life”, and his most recent book is the acclaimed: “The Kid From The South Bronx Who Never Gave Up,” and is the co-author of “Molecular Neurobiology of Addiction Recovery: The 12 Steps Program and Fellowship.”


Over twenty years ago Giordano founded the prestigious G & G Holistic Addiction Treatment Center in North Miami Beach, Florida — a 62 bed in-patient/out-patient JCAHO accredited addiction treatment facility which he started for $300 and then sold in 2012 for $45,000,000 .


Beth Barry

In 1994, Beth founded the mind-body education school, YogaFit, which has certified over

250,000 instructors worldwide. She has written four best-selling books, including Healing

Trauma With Yoga. Beth has spent time studying in India and Asia and enjoys sharing the gift of

yoga beyond borders.


Kristin Mabry


C-IAYT Certified Yoga Therapist, ERYT500 Yoga Alliance Experienced Registered Yoga Teacher, YogaFit Senior Master Trainer, CMT-P International Mindfulness Teacher’s Association Certified Mindfulness Teacher, HeartMath Certified Stress and Resilience Trainer, YogaBody Certified Breathing Coach, TalentSmart Certified Emotional Intelligence Trainer, Trained Professional Coach and International Coaching Federation member working towards Associate Certified Coach



Kristin is motivated to use her skills and passion to empower others to authentically live with purpose, joy, and belonging, congruent with wellbeing and growth. She co-owns a gym, teaches fitness and yoga classes, and maintains a yoga therapy and sound healing practice in addition to her career as a Learning Officer for NOAA Fisheries, where she serves as a mentor, coach, facilitator, trainer, and advocate.


Kelly Gardner


Licensed Professional Counselor


C-IAYT Certified Yoga Therapist


Certified Daring Way Facilitato

Kelly is passionate about supporting others as they navigate their own healing journeys. She empowers others to create a meaningful impact in their own lives and communities by leveraging their unique gifts.


Kelly earned her B.S. degree from the University of Memphis and her M.Ed. in Community Counseling from the University of West Georgia. As a Licensed Professional Counselor, Kelly worked as a trauma specialist for fifteen years before opening her own private coaching practice. She has five years experience of mentoring in coaching and leadership programs and is excited to continue her work in this realm. In her holistic approach, Kelly works to guide others into their radiance by combining her clinical expertise with mindset and shadow work, yoga therapy skills, and the science of habit change.

checklistArray.name: Functionality Testing
Test all Field validation. Optional and Mandatory fields
All forms are correct and submit to appropriate Mail Id
Test for forms displaying a correct message after submission OR redirecting to thank you page
Confirm contact form is working and notifications are set up
Check all social media link
Check all links like internal Link, External Link, broken Link also check buttons.
Test that the 404 page is created or not?
Remove or rename the “admin” username
Search results: results page display properly, the query is displayed
Woo-commerce functionality Testing
Checking that product pages load properly
Adding products to the shopping cart
Checking the shopping cart loads properly
Checking the checkout loads properly
Checking that customers can checkout as a guest
Checking that new customers can register and login at checkout
Checking that existing customers can login at checkout
Checking that existing customers can make a purchase
Testing that the payment process works properly
Testing that customers can complete the checkout process
Check that my account page is proprely load.
Check E-mail template is setup
Usability Testing
The website should be easy to use.
Instructions provided should be very clear.
Check if the instructions provided are perfect to satisfy its purpose.
The main menu should be provided on each page.
Web UI & Responsive Testing
Check favicon & site website title & Tagline
Check meta title & meta discription
Check that website is supported in all browsers and os versions (cross-browser compatible)
Responsive design tested at standard phone & tablet sizes
Please check all pages have atleast one <h1> tag & more than one should not be there.
Header and Footer are created from theme builder (DIVI)
All inner page should be developed from template
Performance Testing
Check website in gtmetrix
Load time of your website should be 3 seconds or less
Make sure all wordpress, theme and plugin updates are installed
Remove unnecessary things from the back end. e.g. extra fields option, page/post, plugins, forms, popups, Remove all dummy contents
Any old website URLs which are still sending traffic should be 301 redirected to new versions of the pages
Also check that child theme is created or not ?
Images are correct and have been optimized for the web (resize all large images) Images are not greater than 400kb

We (Greanta) are a startup specializing in customizable premium leather products, including golf accessories, A4 & A5 notebook holders, and travel essentials. Set up categories and filters to enhance the browsing experience for customers.

Ensure compliance with industry standards for online payment security.

Implement real-time tracking and notifications for customers.

Implement our brand elements cohesively throughout the website, including logo placement, color schemes, and typography.

Create a visually appealing design that aligns with the premium and sophisticated nature of our leather products.

Proven experience in developing e-commerce websites on the Shopify/Wordpress platform.

A portfolio showcasing previous related projects with a focus on aesthetics, functionality, and user experience.

Familiarity with customization features and options available on the chosen platform.

Strong understanding of e-commerce best practices, including payment gateways, shipping, and inventory management.

Ability to incorporate branding elements seamlessly into the website design.

Revamp Shopify Website


Job Title: Shopify Developer for Specialty Food E-commerce Site Revamp


Job Description:


We are looking for an experienced Shopify Developer to overhaul our e-commerce website, with a new focus on candy, snacks, and food gifts. Our aim is to recreate the site with a clean, user-friendly design inspired by the simplicity and functionality of Instacart.


Key Responsibilities:


Conduct a thorough review of our existing website and propose a redesign that emphasizes our new product categories: candy, snacks, and food gifts.

Implement a clean, modern Shopify theme that mirrors the user-friendly experience of Instacart.

Ensure the website is responsive, with a particular focus on mobile usability, reflecting the browsing habits of our target audience.

Enhance product presentation and navigation to make finding and purchasing products straightforward and enjoyable.

Optimize the website for speed, efficiency, and SEO.

Seamlessly integrate any new features, plugins, or customizations required for the site's new focus.

Collaborate with our team to ensure the site aligns with our brand’s vision and goals.

Required Skills:


Proven track record with Shopify platform, focusing on e-commerce for food-related products.

Strong skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Shopify’s Liquid code.

Experience in creating user-friendly, responsive website designs, preferably with examples similar to Instacart’s layout.

Solid understanding of SEO best practices.

Excellent problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.

Effective communication skills for collaboration with our team.

Desirable Skills:


Previous experience in designing e-commerce sites for the food industry, particularly for candy, snacks, or gifts.

Graphic design skills to enhance visual appeal and product presentation.

Project Deliverables:


A redesigned Shopify website focused on candy, snacks, and food gifts, with a clean, user-friendly design akin to Instacart.

Full documentation of the redesign process, including any custom code or unique features added.

Please send your CV with a covering letter that includes a summary of your experience with Shopify and Tailwind CSS, alongside examples of previous work or a portfolio. Be prepared to discuss the specifics of the test issue as part of the application process.

description:
Shopify and Webflow developer(s) needed


[I am actively checking the job post. Even if you see there are 50+ proposals, you can send a cover letter because I am going to check all of them and decline the bad ones.]


We're on the hunt for talented Shopify and Webflow Developer to join our dynamic team.


We can hire someone good at both, or 2 different people: 1 for Shopify and 1 for Webflow, so feel free to apply even if you know only one of the platforms.


About Us:

We are a newly established agency focusing on businesses all over the world who would like to launch or improve their online business. Most of our clients are based on Shopify but we would like to expand on Webflow too. You will work on different websites from different niches.


Responsibilities:

- Develop and maintain Shopify and Webflow-based websites.

- Take Figma files and create websites based on the provided design.

- Customize themes, templates, and plugins to meet project requirements.

- Optimize websites for performance, and responsiveness.

- Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.



Requirements:

- Proven experience in Shopify and Webflow development.

- Proficient in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React and Liquid.

- Strong understanding of e-commerce best practices.

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

- Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.



Perks:

- Earn as much as you work. You will give us your price and we will agree or disagree based on the proposed terms.

- There are performance-based bonuses.

- Flexible remote work arrangements.

- Opportunities for professional development and growth.


I am looking for individuals only. I do not want to collaborate with another agency on this specific matter. We want to stay cost-efficient and we value communication and coding skills. Outdated or impractical solutions are not welcomed, and you should know that I am looking for talented people who are dedicated to their jobs.


I don't want to face embarrassing situations, such as working with a whole team instead of only one individual (when I thought there was only one). What I am truly looking for is a person who pays a lot of attention to the details and would like to grow along with the agency. This will give you projects on the long-term and the chance to earn as much as possible.

Application Outline


The application's visual design will draw inspiration from the color scheme. The predominant colors will be purple (#41506a) and white (#ffffff), reflecting the brand identity. The logo will be prominently positioned at the top of key pages. Additionally, the "About Us" section will succinctly outline the charity mission and vision.


Home Screen

Introduction Tutorial

Daily Reminder / Notifications

My Wallet / Pushka Balance

Settings


Homescreen


The Home Screen will prominently feature the primary Charity portal.


At the top section of the home screen, three coins will be displayed, representing different preset donation amounts. These coins will be customizable, allowing users to adjust the preset values according to their preference. The fourth coin will generate a popup enabling the user to donate a one-time amount.


Upon selecting one of these coins, it will animate as it drops into the chosen charity box, accompanied by the sound of coins jingling. Simultaneously, the running total displayed behind the charity box will be updated to reflect the new contribution.

Introduction Tutorial



Upon the user's initial entry into the app, a tutorial will be presented to guide them through its usage.


If users prefer to bypass the tutorial, they can simply tap the "Get Started" button, which will skip the three-page tutorial.


Daily Reminder / Notifications




Users will have the capability to establish daily reminders, ensuring they remember to contribute to tzedaka. The app will also offer settings for creating reminders on Erev Shabbos (1 hour prior to sunset on Friday at the user's phone location) and Erev Yomtov (1 hour before sunset on Jewish Festivals at the user's phone location).


Furthermore, the app can include predefined dates for 10 special occasions within the year. On these dates, the app will display reminders to users, prompting them to make charitable donations in honor of those specific days. (Yud Tes Kislev, Yud Shevat etc…)


My Wallet / Pushka Balance


At the top of the app interface, users will easily view their available app credit, with the option to add more funds if needed. Furthermore, a comprehensive transaction history detailing all previous user payments to the app will be accessible.


Users will find various options for adding funds via Stripe.


Once funds are credited to the user's account, the funds will be sent to Stripe. Subsequently, users can utilize this credited balance across different charity boxes until the entirety of the balance has been allocated.

Settings Page



The "Settings" section of the app will offer users the ability to personalize the application according to their preferences. This section will also provide convenient quick links to navigate to different areas within the app.


Additionally, users will have the option to directly contact with any questions related to the application.


The "About Us" section will provide a concise overview of the organization's purpose and mission.

Shopify UI/UX Expert

**Company Overview:**

petit seal is a vibrant and fast-growing e-commerce brand specializing in high-end baby and kids products. With a commitment to quality and an exceptional shopping experience. We’re seeking a skilled Shopify UI/UX Expert to elevate our digital storefront and provide our customers with seamless, delightful online shopping experiences.


**Job Summary/Objective:**

The Shopify UI/UX Expert will play a pivotal role in enhancing our online store’s user interface and user experience. The candidate will be responsible for crafting intuitive and aesthetically pleasing interfaces, focusing on user-centered designs, and improving overall functionality to optimize conversion rates.


**Key Responsibilities:**

- **Design Improvement:** Enhance the UI/UX of our Shopify store ensuring it’s visually appealing and easy to navigate.

- **User Testing:** Conduct usability tests and analyze user feedback to improve interface design.

- **Collaboration:** Work closely with developers and marketing team to ensure design consistency and improve user experience.

- **Data-Driven Decisions:** Use analytics and A/B testing to drive design improvements and optimize user flow.

- **Mobile-First Design:** Ensure our platform provides an excellent user experience across all devices, especially on mobile.


**Qualifications and Requirements:**

- Proven experience as a UI/UX Designer or similar role with a portfolio of design projects.

- Proficiency in design software (e.g., UXPin, Balsamiq).

- Experience with Shopify’s platform and Liquid code is mandatory.

- Strong aesthetic skills with the ability to combine various colors, fonts, and layouts.

- Understanding of e-commerce best practices and current web standards.


**Skills and Competencies:**

- **Creativity:** Ability to solve problems creatively and effectively.

- **Communication:** Strong communication skills to convey design ideas to the team.

- **Analytical Thinking:** Ability to analyze customer behavior and implement changes accordingly.

- **Attention to Detail:** Ensure all design elements, layouts, and information are aligned with company branding.

description:
Shopify Developer for essential oils shop

Looking for a skilled and experienced Shopify website developer to recreate our luxury essential oils store. The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of the Shopify platform.


Responsibilities:


Design:

- Develop a visually appealing and responsive design consistent with our brand image.

- Create an intuitive interface for customers to browse and purchase products.


Product Display:

- Add, edit, and delete products with ease, including product images, descriptions, prices, and options (e.g., size and color).

- Establish links between products and enable viewing of recommended items.

- Implement product categories and filters to enhance customer searchability.

- Enable zoom-in functionality for product images.

- Incorporate a product reviews and ratings system.


Shopping Cart:

- Develop a secure shopping cart that allows customers to adjust quantities, view items, and proceed to checkout.

- Provide an option for customers to save items in their cart for later.

- Support multiple payment methods, including credit cards and PayPal.

- Integrate a feature for customers to purchase credit gift vouchers for themselves or as gifts for friends.


Shipping and Tax:

- Setup shipping rates based on weight, destination, and shipping method.

- Implement tax calculations and inclusion in orders as required.


SEO Optimization:

- Utilize appropriate header tags, meta descriptions, and product tags for improved search engine visibility.

- Integrate Google Analytics to track website traffic.


Mobile Optimization:

- Develop a mobile-friendly version of the website optimized for smaller screens and touch-based navigation.


Customer Service:

- Include a contact form for customers to reach out with questions or concerns.

- Create an FAQ page with commonly asked questions.


Reporting and Analytics:

- Provide sales and customer reports to monitor website performance.

- Implement inventory tracking to manage product stock levels.


Marketing:

- Integrate social media channels to promote the brand and products.

- Incorporate email marketing tools for targeted campaigns and newsletters.

- Enable the creation and management of discounts, promotions, and voucher gift cards.


Requirements:


- Proven experience in building e-commerce websites on the Shopify platform.

- Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

- Experience in customizing Shopify themes and developing custom themes.

- Knowledge of search engine optimization (SEO) best practices.

- Portfolio showcasing previous e-commerce websites(in beauty niche especially).

- Excellent communication skills and attention to detail.


To apply, please send your portfolio, and a brief summary of your experience with Shopify.

Shopify E-commerce Custom Developer

Position Overview:

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Shopify E-Commerce Website Developer for a 3-month term to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate should possess strong technical expertise in Shopify development, have a keen eye for detail, and the ability to offer innovative solutions to enhance our online store's custom functionality, user experience, and visual appeal. The candidate should be fluent in English, capable of effective communication, and dedicated to delivering high-quality work within specified timelines.


Responsibilities:


Collaborate closely with the Brand Manager and SEO implementation team to understand project requirements and implement requested features, designs, and functionalities on the Shopify e-commerce website.

Identify, diagnose, and resolve bugs, glitches, and issues affecting the website's performance and user experience.

Evaluate and recommend suitable Shopify apps to enhance website functionality and seamlessly integrate them as required.

Provide valuable insights and suggestions to optimize the website's usability, accessibility, and visual presentation, aligning with industry best practices and current design trends.

Take ownership of assigned tasks, outline reasonable project timelines, and consistently deliver quality deliverables within the agreed-upon timeframes.

Effectively communicate project progress, potential roadblocks, and proposed solutions to the project lead and relevant stakeholders.

Collaborate with the design and content teams to ensure that the website maintains a cohesive and visually appealing appearance that aligns with the brand's identity.

Stay up-to-date with the latest developments in Shopify, e-commerce, and web development to bring innovative ideas and solutions to the team.

Qualifications:


Proven experience as a Shopify developer with a strong portfolio of previous e-commerce projects.

Proficiency in Shopify Liquid programming language, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Familiarity with responsive design principles and mobile-first development.

Ability to understand project objectives, propose innovative solutions, and implement them effectively.

Strong problem-solving skills with a meticulous attention to detail.

Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal, to effectively convey ideas, project updates, and potential challenges.

Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.

Prior experience in bug identification and resolution on Shopify platforms.

Knowledge of SEO best practices as they relate to e-commerce websites is a plus.

Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.

Terms and Conditions:


This is a 3-month term position, with the potential for extension based on performance and project requirements.

The developer must adhere to clear project timelines and consistently deliver quality work on time.

Any misleading behavior or failure to meet project requirements may result in the termination of the agreement.

If you are a motivated and skilled Shopify E-Commerce Website Developer looking to contribute to a dynamic team and make a significant impact on our online presence, we encourage you to apply with your updated resume and a portfolio showcasing your relevant work.
